value: ECN MILENA indirect (allothermal) twin-bed gasifier at atmospheric pressure with OLGA oil-scrubber tar removal, deep S/Cl removal, pre-reformer, nickel-catalyst methanation and CO2/H2O removal, producing grid-quality bio-methane (bio-SNG) from wood. The gasification riser runs at 850 degC with steam; char, tar and dust burn in a bubbling-bed combustor heating the sand to about 925 degC. No air enters the gas, so the producer gas is nearly N2-free

note: lab scale 30 kWth (2004) and pilot 800 kWth / 160 kg/h (2008, 250 h test on demolition wood 2010); a 12 MWth demonstration in Alkmaar (HVC) planned, construction 2013. OLGA is commercially available from Dahlman.

overall efficiency wood to bio-methane, LHV basis, calculated for a commercial-size plant on residual wood at 25% moisture.
